digest.component_or_area: test design standards and convergence test patterns
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive an external effect (e.g. Jira landed body) instead of capturing it from the real call site remain green when the send path drifts, defeating their purpose.

Two instances in the same module re-derived their oracles: truncate_comment_body model went stale when send path moved to AdfCodec.fit_outbound, and an initial bug fix re-derived the composition instead of capturing the call-site output.
The defect was fixed by landed commit 103729e90c to capture the --body argument from real acli_cli_ops.add_comment call with only acli_subprocess._run_acli stubbed.

A mechanical lint to flag re-derived oracles cannot distinguish legitimate uses (characterization tests calling both helpers, unit tests of the helpers themselves) from defective ones based on syntax alone; intent is not recoverable from AST.
The rule that convergence tests must capture external effects from real call sites, never re-derive them, must be documented as authoring guidance in the shared test-design standard.
Documentation changes sync the capture-don't-re-derive rule with worked examples across canonical and per-skill test-design.md copies, gated by existing test_skill_shared_sync.py validation.
